incident-bot: PAGER — service=genqueue region=eu-west-1 severity=high — observed increased latency and 502s. Incident ID INC-20260317-03. Link: https://pager.redwood.io/INC-20260317-03

Tina: taking oncall. I'm seeing elevated p95 ~650ms for text.generate in eu-west-1. Confirmed by Kevin.

Kevin: i'm on it, checking recent deploys. no new deploys in the last 30m. rolling back a staging flag now.

Tina: quick ask — need a status page initial blurb. Draft below, pls review:

Tina: DRAFT STATUSPAGE: We're investigating increased latency affecting text generation in eu-west-1. Some requests may fail with 502. Engineers are investigating; no ETA yet. We'll post updates every 15 minutes.

ops-lead: suggest softening "may fail" -> "may experience errors or increased latency". Also add impacted customer guidance: retry with backoff or route to fallback region.

cs-rep: can we add a note for customers using Dedicated pools? Are they impacted?

Kevin: Dedicated pools not affected; issue is in shared genqueue for hosted inference. Add: "Dedicated/reserved capacity customers not impacted."

Legal: pls avoid implying root cause. use "we're aware and working on it." Keep short.

Tina: updated draft:

Tina: DRAFT STATUSPAGE v2: We are aware of increased latency and errors affecting text generation in eu-west-1. A subset of hosted API requests may see increased latency or 502 errors. Dedicated/reserved capacity customers are not impacted. Engineers are actively working on mitigation. Next update in 15 minutes.

Maria: LGTM, :eyes: can we include "workaround" guidance — use region override header? e.g., X-Region: us-west-2

Tina: added workaround line. final draft below, ready to publish on my mark:

Tina: FINAL STATUSPAGE: We are aware of increased latency and errors affecting text generation in eu-west-1. A subset of hosted API requests may see increased latency or 502 errors. Dedicated/reserved capacity customers are not impacted. As a temporary workaround, you can route requests to another region (e.g., us-west-2) by setting X-Region or using the region param. Engineers are actively working on mitigation. Next update at 15:45 UTC.

ops-lead: publish when ready. I'll post customer advisory in support channels after.

Tina: publishing now. Posting to status.redwood.com and sending CS note.

incident-bot: STATUSPAGE PUBLISHED — https://status.redwood.com/incidents/INC-20260317-03 :thumbsup:

cs-rep: sending templated email to customers affected, will share copy here.

Kevin: quick debug note — found increased queue depth on genqueue-worker-14, OOM kills reported:

Kevin: ```json
{"ts":"1742109876","worker":"genqueue-worker-14","msg":"oom_kill","rss":"3.1GB"}
```

Tina: thx, saving logs to incident folder. continue updates in thread."
